subject.title: [Feature]: Add one-way dispatch mode for A2A handoffs without reply-back ping-pong

question: Should OpenClaw add dispatch-only A2A semantics as a `sessions_send` mode/flag, a separate delivery primitive, or defer it into the broader structured handoff contract?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the fix changes public model-facing tool semantics and session-delivery behavior, and it overlaps several open A2A handoff and announce-control requests.

options.title: Add an explicit `sessions_send` dispatch mode
options.body: Preserve current conversation behavior by default and add an additive per-call mode that persists the target message without requester reply-back or announce delivery.

options.title: Create a separate one-way primitive
options.body: Introduce a new `sessions_deliver` or `sessions_enqueue` style tool to keep dispatch semantics separate from conversational `sessions_send`.

options.title: Fold into structured handoff work
options.body: Keep this issue open as acceptance criteria for a broader A2A handoff API that also covers structured skip/no-reply actions and announce routing.

recommendation.title: Add an explicit `sessions_send` dispatch mode
recommendation.body: Preserve current conversation behavior by default and add an additive per-call mode that persists the target message without requester reply-back or announce delivery.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from A2A feature history and adjacent maintainer scoping comments on the handoff contract surface.
